blurb: Brochin Expeditions offers inshore, near shore, and offshore saltwater safaris out of Panama City Beach, Florida, specializing in catch, clean & cook adventures. They also provide Texas hunting safari packages with various trophy hunting options and all-inclusive amenities. Their Florida hunting expeditions are free range and guided by master outdoorsman Eddie Brochin.
